note: Wooded hills along Parks Creek north of Grovespring, with two small primitive camping areas beside gravel lots: one at Little Smittle Cave, reached by a low-water crossing of Parks Creek (impassable when the creek is up), and one at Lowell Cave on the east side of Parks Creek Road. No amenities. --Claude
summary: Confirmed with a creek-crossing caveat: page 'Designated Camping Sites / Individual Campsites', Rule 140 standard; map (04/16) two Primitive Camping Area symbols, at the Little Smittle Cave lot (= GIS 34 / stored pin, west of Parks Creek) and the Lowell Cave lot; the road to the pin fords Parks Creek on a low-water slab. Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights now manual. Not waterfront kept. Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT caveat: area page 'Things to Do When You Visit: Camping: Designated Camping Sites, Individual Campsites'; Rule 140 standard, no special-use-permit-only rule, no Rule 101; no brochure on the page, only the map. The map (04/16) draws two 'Primitive Camping Area' symbols, each beside a parking lot: (1) the Little Smittle Cave lot west of Parks Creek = GIS camping point 34 and lot 1970 = the stored pin; (2) the Lowell Cave lot, a short spur east off Parks Creek Road about 800 m SE (not in the GIS layers). Imagery: the gravel road from the Parks Creek Road lot (1968) runs west along a field edge and crosses Parks Creek on what looks like a concrete low-water slab with the creek flowing over/around it (about 37.45834,-92.62510), then climbs to a gravel lot about 40 x 15 m at the camp. A 23-ft 2WD rig can use a slab at normal flow but not in high water; MDC posts no warning. Proposed caveat in the note. The Lowell Cave camp needs no crossing: a small dirt pull-off about 50 m long beside Parks Creek Road (about 37.4514,-92.6204 on imagery, scaled from the map).
PIN: stored 37.45691,-92.62626 is GIS point 34, at the south edge of lot 1970 (17 m); keep it, or 37.45705,-92.62635 for the lot centre.
CLUSTERS: two small lot-side camps 800 m apart on the same Parks Creek Road access; no split proposed. near.py finds no other entry within 3 km.

WATERFRONT (not waterfront, kept): the Little Smittle Cave lot is about 85 m from Parks Creek (about 10 m wide) through woods; no open apron. Lowell Cave is on the far side of the road from the creek.
Season (manual, year-round) left as stored. The 2027 MDC permit is in the policy row and isn't written per entry.
